fields.definition: A `Query` whose parameterized SQL text lives in a file deployed beside the application rather than compiled into application binaries, executing with `CommandType.Text`. The default folder is `SQL` and the default extension is `.sql` (or `.psql` once PostgreSQL services are registered via `QueryStatement.Extension`). A host that registers both SQL Server and PostgreSQL services can use `SqlQueryStatement` (`.sql`) and `PgQueryStatement` (`.psql`) to avoid sharing the process-wide default extension. The SQL file is loaded lazily on first use and cached. On PostgreSQL (`Npgsql` 7+), `QueryStatement` is required when invoking PostgreSQL functions (`SELECT * FROM fn(...)`), because `QueryProcedure` (`CommandType.StoredProcedure`) emits `CALL` and invokes `CREATE PROCEDURE` routines only.
fields.name: QueryStatement
